blocks.text: Fig 19.1 ka curve yeh bhi dikhata hai ke binding energy fi nucleon A = 50 tak barhti hai. Is liye jab do halke nuclei mil kar 50 se kam mass number ka bhari nucleus banayein to tawanai nikalti hai. Maslan jab do protons aur do neutrons mil kar helium nucleus banate hain to taqreeban 27 MeV nikalti hai.

blocks.title: Fusion reaction
blocks.text: Fusion reaction woh nuclear reaction hai jis mein do halke nuclei mil kar bhari nucleus banate hain.

Fusion reaction mein kuch kamiyat zaya hoti aur us ke barabar tawanai nikalti hai; fission ke muqable fi nucleon zyada tawanai mil sakti hai. Lekin fusion karna zyada mushkil hai: do musbat charge wale nuclei ko bohat qareeb lana parta hai, jis ke liye un ki electrostatic dhakelne wali quwwat ke khilaf kaam chahiye, is liye reaction shuru karne ke liye bohat tawanai kharch karni parti hai. Halke nuclei ke sab se mumkina fusion reactions 2-1-H + 2-1-H -> 3-1-H + 1-1-H + 4.0 MeV (19.6) aur 2-1-H + 2-1-H -> 3-2-He + 1-0-n + 3.3 MeV (19.7) hain. Agar deuterium (2-1-H) aur tritium (3-1-H) ko jabran fuse kiya jaye to 17.6 MeV milti hai: 2-1-H + 3-1-H -> 4-2-He + 1-0-n + 17.6 MeV (19.8). Deuterium aur tritium fusion fuels kehlate hain.

blocks.title: Fusion mein fi nucleon tawanai
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke reactions 19.6 aur 19.7 mein 'fi nucleon taqreeban 1.0 MeV paida hoti hai, jo fission ki tawanai ke barabar hai'. 4.0 MeV, 4 nucleons mein bati, 1.0 MeV fi nucleon hai, lekin fission uranium ki sirf taqreeban 0.9 MeV fi nucleon deta hai (200 MeV / 235). Deuterium-tritium reaction 17.6/5 = 3.5 MeV fi nucleon deta hai, fission se kai guna zyada. Kitab ke 'fusion fuels 1-1-H + 3-1-H' se murad deuterium (2-1-H) aur tritium (3-1-H) hain.

blocks.alt: Do deuterium nuclei (har aik aik proton aur aik neutron) takra kar tritium nucleus (do neutrons aur aik proton) aur urta hua proton banate hain (4.0 MeV). Phir yahi tritium aur aik aur deuterium takra kar helium nucleus (do protons, do neutrons) aur urta hua neutron banate hain (17.6 MeV). Key: neutron, proton, deuterium, tritium, helium.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.6: fusion reaction (kitab ki Figure 19.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle qadam mein do deuterium mil kar tritium aur aik proton banate hain (4.0 MeV, reaction 19.6). 'Then' ke baad yahi tritium aik aur deuterium se mil kar helium aur aik neutron banata hai (17.6 MeV, reaction 19.8). Lehriya lakeerein urne wale zarre ki harkat dikhati hain.

Do halke nuclei fuse karne ke liye un ki dhakel ke khilaf kaam karna parta hai, is liye unhein bohat tez raftar se takraya jata hai. Aik tareeqa accelerator se nuclei ko bohat zyada raftar dena hai (Fig 19.6); yeh deuterium aur tritium ke fusion ki tehqeeq mein use hua hai lekin bare paimane par mustaqil tawanai nahi de sakta. Doosra tareeqa is haqeeqat par mabni hai ke darja hararat ke saath atoms ki raftar barhti hai. Darkaar darja hararat taqreeban 10 million darje Celsius hai; aise darja hararat par reaction thermonuclear reaction kehlata hai. Aisa darja hararat aam taur par hasil nahi hota, lekin atom bomb ke dhamake mein bohat kam waqt ke liye hota hai, isi se hydrogen bomb chalaya jata hai. Fusion abhi fission ki tarah qaboo nahi hua, is liye bijli banane mein use nahi hota, agarche tehqeeq jari hai. Fusion Sooraj aur doosre sitaron ke markaz mein ho raha hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: 'masnoi Sooraj'
blocks.text: 'Masnoi Sooraj' se murad China ke EAST (jadeed superconducting tokamak) aur HL-2M/HL-3 jaise tajurbati fusion reactors hain. Yeh taqatwar magnetic fields se hydrogen isotopes ko qaid karte hain jo 100 million darje se zyada, Sooraj ke markaz se bhi garam, kiye jate hain, taake unhein helium mein fuse kar ke saaf tawanai hasil ki ja sake.
